design:
Phase 4 pass goal: a real, headless daemon flow for indexed retrieval, asynchronous weaving/title fill, conversational development, and both Markdown export modes. No Next.js or visual work.

Settled user behavior:
- A single retained reply links to every development it produced. Search opens the latest eligible development. If any associated development is rejected, the shared reply is excluded from AI access.
- Explicit Stop retains confirmed saved work and marks unfinished replies interrupted. Leaving/disconnecting does not cancel the daemon-owned run. Uncertain admission/completion is reconciled before any replacement submission.
- Agentic effort is Quick / Standard (default) / Thorough, mapped to supported model effort or variants. No application turn, token, cost, search-count, or note-count quotas. Transport failure handling is not an effort budget.

Sequential implementation scopes, with test-first bounded cycles and checkpoint commits:
1. Shared response associations and durable run/operation foundation: immutable retained complete/interrupted response text; stable run/prompt/operation identities; mutable lifecycle state; atomic input admission and domain-operation receipts; resume observation rather than duplicate execution. Keep current data and rejection behavior through isolated migrations.
2. FTS5 plus reproducibly built/loaded spellfix1 retrieval, scoped search/filter/count/sort boundary, and Simple Markdown tree export. Search current titles and full responses, enforce shared-response rejection visibility, generate original-text excerpts, and skip rejected export nodes while walking to active descendants. Numeric ranking/tie-break choices are implementation tuning, not new product gates.
3. OpenCode public-client adapter and narrow application capability surface; asynchronous weaver and Evolve worker. Attach only to configured operator-managed service, allow newer versions through capability checks, fresh explicit-context agent run per reply, durable recovery. Title fill, interpretations, developments and categorized connections use domain commands; no raw DB/file tools or user-role credential exposure. Native isolated fake-provider fixtures may validate integration without paid calls or changing the shared service.
4. Read-only Agentic Markdown export and whole-flow verification. Report cites stable source identities, gathers existing thinking, and cannot use knowledge-write operations. Effort selects native effort/variant only. Extend manual scripts, schema/API/startup/testing docs and accurate README status.

Safety and integration design:
- All actual agent context comes from scoped application reads. Track exposed context references and revalidate eligibility before subsequent submissions/output publication/domain writes; rejection during a run must not allow new use of rejected material. Saved work is never silently undone.
- Model proposals/tool requests cross typed, run-scoped application capabilities; operation receipts prevent replayed tool results from creating duplicates. Export receives no write capability. Session deny rules are defense-in-depth, not a universal sandbox for arbitrary operator plugins; explicitly document operator-service trust.
- Bind generated reply associations in issued order, not random-ID order. Interrupted output is not silently promoted as a completed fallback development.
- Discover/load native spellfix1 from a known artifact, not an assumed system module. Build and runtime capability checks must be reproducible and fail actionably, never silently substitute another fuzzy engine.
- No live operator credentials, paid model calls or service lifecycle changes during development without explicit authorization. Production configuration and unavailable-service state must remain honest; capture success does not depend on AI availability.

description: Expose the verified phase-1 domain operations through a Hono daemon running with Bun. Keep transport handlers separate from business logic and make the operations usable without a browser. The eventual browser must use the Next.js server, never access the daemon directly. This phase covers the foundation API, not the full later agent/search/export surface. Source of truth: .lore/context/architecture.md and the related context files. design: Plan: preserve Phase1 domain model. Slice A Hono createApp factory with injected domain/rejection service and narrow creation port; routes for thought creation/scoped reads with parent linkage (tree inspection), separate connection creation/reads, response lookup, user-only single/branch reject/restore and branch preview/confirmation. Resolve actor from distinct configured bearer credentials, never body/query. Default deny unknown credentials; AI cannot request human history/show-rejected, spoof user authorship or use rejected inputs through write routes. Stable HTTP errors for malformed requests, missing references, forbidden actors, stale confirmation/conflicts; log boundary attempts/outcomes without secrets/content. Unit request tests use test-owned domain/repository mocks/fixtures, not production data. Slice B Bun startup opens configured SQLite, runs migrations, wires services/ports and app.fetch, explicitly binds127.0.0.1 (Bun defaults all interfaces), validates config/credentials fail-closed, lifecycle cleanup and real HTTP isolated-SQLite smoke. No permissive CORS or browser credential access; future Next.js server owns calls. No OpenCode/UI/search/export implementation. Validation: test-first each slice, independent read-only RED/GREEN tester, oracle bun-typescript-reviewer per changed scope, final combined suite/typecheck and checkpoint. Fixer is test-author and production writer in separate invocations; independent fixer session testing; oracle review. Existing 40 tests protect domain foundation. Runtime dependencies resolve Hono through Bun lockfile, no guessed latest version. No speculative routes or screen-shaped persistence.

title: Phase 3: Provide practical Bun scripts for daemon testing
description: Provide simple runnable Bun scripts that exercise the phase-2 daemon API directly. The user should be able to capture thoughts, construct example evolution branches without real AI, inspect them, and reject/restore selected thoughts and subtrees. Scripts need useful output and instructions, not a polished CLI. They complement automated tests. Extend them with search and export scenarios as those capabilities arrive in phase 4; those features are not prerequisites for this foundation milestone. Source of truth: .lore/context/architecture.md and the related context files. Keep business rules independent of screens. No implementation is requested by creation of this tracking issue. Before implementing the sequence, use a dedicated working branch and checkpoint each completed, verified bead. Do not push or sync without approval.
design: Plan: one bounded delivery of practical Bun scripts, no polished CLI. A small authenticated HTTP request helper for existing loopback daemon, supporting method/path/optionalJSON and explicit user/AI role with matching server credential; reject invalid config before network, bounded fetch/body, useful nonzero errors without secrets. An isolated walkthrough owns ephemeral daemon/tempSQLite/test credentials and exercises capture, branching with simulated AI-authored records via API, normal/history/AI inspection, reject-single preserves active descendants, branch confirmation and partial-subtree restoration, independent connection rejection. All data operations HTTP only; shared startDaemon allowed solely fixture lifecycle. No attachment to production daemon for demo, no raw SQL/domain manipulation. Own-resource finally cleanup, clear step/result output, repeatable fresh IDs. Package entry scripts and README copy/paste examples provide manual capture/inspect/reject/restore using actual route shapes. Test-first script config/request/error behavior with controlled fetch/deps, isolated end-to-end walkthrough test, no duplication of existing daemon API matrix. Roles: fixer test-author and production (separate turns), independent fixer read-only RED/GREEN/fullsuite, fresh oracle bun-typescript-reviewer for CLI/daemon boundary review. No Phase1/2 code rewrites, no OpenCode/search/export/UI implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Document and run a reproducible foundation scenario against isolated test data, including an active descendant of a rejected thought and partial subtree restoration. Commands report results/failures clearly, require no visual client or real AI, and do not bypass daemon business rules. Existing automated tests remain in place.
